void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool includes_text(string[] choices, string value)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == value
            return true
    return false

string upper_ascii(string text)
    result := ""
    lower := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    upper := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    for: i < #text
        match lower.find(text[i])
            nat at
                result += upper[at]
            none
                result += text[i]
    return result

string printable_ascii()
    return " !" + DQ + "#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{{|}}~"

bool compile_only(string name)
    return includes_text("IF ELSE THEN DO ?DO LOOP +LOOP LEAVE UNLOOP I J BEGIN UNTIL WHILE REPEAT AGAIN CASE OF ENDOF ENDCASE EXIT RECURSE DOES> ; >R R> R@".split(" ").concat(["ABORT" + DQ, "[']", "{{:"]), name)

bool interpret_only(string name)
    return includes_text([":", ":NONAME", "FORGET"], name)

bool special_word(string name)
    return compile_only(name) or interpret_only(name) or includes_text(["." + DQ, "(", "\", "TO", "IS"], name)

int | none parse_digits(string text, int base)
    negative := text.starts_with("-")
    digits := if negative then text[1:] else text
    if digits == ""
        return none
    result := 0
    alphabet := "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    for: i < #digits
        match alphabet.find(upper_ascii(digits[i]))
            nat digit
                if int(digit) >= base
                    return none
                result = result * base + int(digit)
            none
                return none
    return if negative then -result else result

int floor_quotient(int a, int b)
    q := a / b
    return if a % b != 0 and ((a < 0) != (b < 0)) then q - 1 else q

int forth_flag(bool condition)
    return if condition then -1 else 0

class Instruction(string op, string token, argument := 0, text := "", nat[] slots := [])
class ControlRecord(string kind, nat origin := 0, nat[] references := [])
class Definition(string name, string display, int creation_here)
    Instruction[] body := []
    ControlRecord[] controls := []
    local_names := map<string, nat>()
    nat local_count := 0
class ForthWord(string name, string kind)
    definition_id := -1
    address := 0
    value := 0
    creation_here := 0
    does_definition := -1
    nat does_start := 0
    target_word := -1
    nat xt_number := 0

class Interpreter()
    int[] data_stack := []
    int[] return_stack := []
    memory := [10]
    ForthWord[] word_pool := []
    nat builtin_count := 0
    nat[] dictionary := []
    nat[] execution_tokens := []
    Definition[] definitions := []
    compiling_id := -1
    nat nesting_depth := 0
    pending := ""
    input_line := ""
    nat read_position := 0
    failure_reason := ""
    failure_word := ""
    failure_code := 0
    failure_catchable := false

    void .initialize()
        names := "+ - * / MOD /MOD */ */MOD NEGATE ABS MIN MAX 1+ 1- 2* 2/ = <> < > 0= 0<> 0< 0> WITHIN TRUE FALSE AND OR XOR INVERT DUP ?DUP DROP SWAP OVER ROT -ROT NIP TUCK 2DUP 2DROP 2SWAP 2OVER DEPTH PICK ROLL . .R .S ? CR EMIT SPACE SPACES BL ! @ +! , ALLOT HERE CELLS CELL+ BASE HEX DECIMAL CREATE VARIABLE CONSTANT VALUE DEFER ' EXECUTE CATCH THROW ABORT WORDS".split(" ")
        for name := names[]
            word_pool = word_pool.append(ForthWord(name, "builtin"))
        builtin_count = #word_pool

    error .fail_with(string reason, code := 0, catchable := true, token := "")
        failure_reason = reason
        failure_word = token
        failure_code = code
        failure_catchable = catchable
        return error("forth failure")

    void | error .push_data(int value)
        if #data_stack == 1000
            return .fail_with("stack overflow", -3)
        data_stack = data_stack.append(value)
        return void

    int | error .pop_data()
        if #data_stack == 0
            return .fail_with("stack underflow", -4)
        result := data_stack[-1]
        data_stack = data_stack[:<#data_stack - 1]
        return result

    int[] | error .take_data(nat count)
        if #data_stack < count
            return .fail_with("stack underflow", -4)
        at := #data_stack - count
        result := data_stack[at:]
        data_stack = data_stack[:<at]
        return result

    void | error .push_values(int[] values)
        for value := values[]
            try .push_data(value)
        return void

    void | error .push_return(int value)
        if #return_stack == 1000
            return .fail_with("return stack overflow", -5)
        return_stack = return_stack.append(value)
        return void

    void | error .require_return(nat count)
        if #return_stack < count
            return .fail_with("return stack underflow", -6)
        return void

    int here_address()
        return int(#memory) * 8

    nat | error .cell_index(int address)
        if address < 0 or address % 8 != 0 or address >= here_address()
            return .fail_with("invalid address", -9)
        return nat(address / 8)

    int | error .radix()
        int base := memory[0]
        if base < 2 or base > 36
            return .fail_with("invalid base", -40)
        return base

    int | none | error .parse_number(string text, fixed_base := false)
        if #text == 3 and text[0] == "'" and text[2] == "'"
            match printable_ascii().find(text[1])
                nat at
                    return int(at) + 32
                none
                    return none
        if text[0] == "$" or text[0] == "#" or text[0] == "%"
            base := if text[0] == "$" then 16 else (if text[0] == "#" then 10 else 2)
            return parse_digits(text[1:], base)
        int base := if fixed_base then 10 else try .radix()
        return parse_digits(text, base)

    int | error .number_literal(string text)
        match .parse_number(text)
            int value
                return value
            none
                return .fail_with("undefined word", -13)
            error failure
                return failure

    string | error .format_number(int number)
        int base := try .radix()
        value := if number < 0 then -number else number
        alphabet := "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        result := alphabet[value % base]
        while value >= base
            value = value / base
            result = alphabet[value % base] + result
        return (if number < 0 then "-" else "") + result

    void .flush_line()
        while #pending > 0 and pending[#pending - 1] == " "
            pending = pending[:<#pending - 1]
        emit(pending)
        pending = ""

    string .read_word()
        while read_position < #input_line and input_line[read_position] == " "
            read_position += 1
        start := read_position
        while read_position < #input_line and input_line[read_position] != " "
            read_position += 1
        return input_line[start:<read_position]

    string | error .read_name()
        string name := .read_word()
        if name == ""
            return .fail_with("missing name", -16)
        return name

    string | error .read_string()
        start := read_position + 1
        if start > #input_line
            return .fail_with("unterminated string", catchable = false)
        match input_line[start:].find(DQ)
            nat at
                read_position = start + at + 1
                return input_line[start:<start + at]
            none
                return .fail_with("unterminated string", catchable = false)

    int find_word(string name)
        for: #dictionary > i >= 0
            id := dictionary[i]
            if word_pool[id].name == name
                return int(id)
        for: id < builtin_count
            if word_pool[id].name == name
                return int(id)
        return -1

    nat | error .existing_word(string name)
        int id := find_word(upper_ascii(name))
        if id < 0
            return .fail_with("undefined word", -13, token = name)
        return nat(id)

    void | error .check_name(string name)
        if special_word(upper_ascii(name))
            return .fail_with("invalid name", -19, token = name)
        match .parse_number(name, true)
            int value
                return .fail_with("invalid name", -19, token = name)
            none
                void
            error failure
                return failure
        return void

    string | error .new_name()
        string name := try .read_name()
        try .check_name(name)
        return upper_ascii(name)

    void .add_word(ForthWord item)
        item.creation_here = here_address()
        dictionary = dictionary.append(#word_pool)
        word_pool = word_pool.append(item)

    nat .token_of(nat word_id)
        if word_pool[word_id].xt_number == 0
            execution_tokens = execution_tokens.append(word_id)
            word_pool[word_id].xt_number = #execution_tokens
        return word_pool[word_id].xt_number

    nat | error .token_word(int xt)
        if xt < 1 or xt > int(#execution_tokens)
            return .fail_with("invalid argument", -24)
        return execution_tokens[xt - 1]

    void | error .set_deferred(nat word_id)
        int xt := try .pop_data()
        nat target := try .token_word(xt)
        word_pool[word_id].target_word = int(target)
        return void

    void | error .execute_word(nat word_id, string token)
        while word_pool[word_id].kind == "defer"
            target := word_pool[word_id].target_word
            if target < 0
                return .fail_with("deferred word not set", -21, token = token)
            word_id = nat(target)
            token = word_pool[word_id].name
        match .execute_inner(word_id)
            void
                void
            error failure
                if failure_word == ""
                    failure_word = token
                return failure
        return void

    void | error .execute_inner(nat word_id)
        item := word_pool[word_id]
        if item.kind == "builtin"
            return .builtin(item.name)
        if item.kind == "colon"
            return .run_definition(nat(item.definition_id), 0)
        if item.kind == "create" or item.kind == "variable"
            try .push_data(item.address)
            if item.does_definition >= 0
                try .run_definition(nat(item.does_definition), item.does_start)
        elif item.kind == "constant"
            try .push_data(item.value)
        elif item.kind == "value"
            try .push_data(memory[item.address / 8])
        return void

    void | error .builtin(string name)
        if includes_text(["+", "-", "*", "/", "MOD", "/MOD", "*/", "*/MOD", "MIN", "MAX", "=", "<>", "<", ">", "AND", "OR", "XOR", "WITHIN"], name)
            int[] values := try .take_data(if includes_text(["*/", "*/MOD", "WITHIN"], name) then 3 else 2)
            a := values[0]
            b := values[1]
            if includes_text(["/", "MOD", "/MOD", "*/", "*/MOD"], name)
                if #values == 3
                    a *= b
                    b = values[2]
                if b == 0
                    return .fail_with("division by zero", -10)
                q := floor_quotient(a, b)
                remainder := a - b * q
                if name == "/MOD" or name == "*/MOD"
                    try .push_values([remainder, q])
                else
                    try .push_data(if name == "MOD" then remainder else q)
            else
                result := 0
                if name == "+"
                    result = a + b
                elif name == "-"
                    result = a - b
                elif name == "*"
                    result = a * b
                elif name == "MIN"
                    result = if a < b then a else b
                elif name == "MAX"
                    result = if a > b then a else b
                elif name == "AND"
                    result = int(int32(a) AND int32(b))
                elif name == "OR"
                    result = int(int32(a) OR int32(b))
                elif name == "XOR"
                    result = int(int32(a) XOR int32(b))
                elif name == "="
                    result = forth_flag(a == b)
                elif name == "<>"
                    result = forth_flag(a != b)
                elif name == "<"
                    result = forth_flag(a < b)
                elif name == ">"
                    result = forth_flag(a > b)
                else
                    result = forth_flag(values[1] <= a and a < values[2])
                try .push_data(result)
        elif includes_text(["NEGATE", "ABS", "1+", "1-", "2*", "2/", "0=", "0<>", "0<", "0>", "INVERT", "CELLS", "CELL+"], name)
            int a := try .pop_data()
            result := 0
            if name == "NEGATE"
                result = -a
            elif name == "ABS"
                result = if a < 0 then -a else a
            elif name == "1+"
                result = a + 1
            elif name == "1-"
                result = a - 1
            elif name == "2*"
                result = 2 * a
            elif name == "2/"
                result = floor_quotient(a, 2)
            elif name == "INVERT"
                result = -a - 1
            elif name == "CELLS"
                result = a * 8
            elif name == "CELL+"
                result = a + 8
            else
                result = forth_flag(if name == "0=" then a == 0 else (if name == "0<>" then a != 0 else (if name == "0<" then a < 0 else a > 0)))
            try .push_data(result)
        elif includes_text(["DUP", "?DUP", "DROP", "SWAP", "OVER", "ROT", "-ROT", "NIP", "TUCK", "2DUP", "2DROP", "2SWAP", "2OVER"], name)
            nat count := if includes_text(["DUP", "?DUP", "DROP"], name) then 1 else (if name == "ROT" or name == "-ROT" then 3 else (if name == "2SWAP" or name == "2OVER" then 4 else 2))
            int[] values := try .take_data(count)
            nat[] order := []
            if name == "DUP" or (name == "?DUP" and values[0] != 0)
                order = [0, 0]
            elif name == "?DUP"
                order = [0]
            elif name == "SWAP"
                order = [1, 0]
            elif name == "OVER"
                order = [0, 1, 0]
            elif name == "ROT"
                order = [1, 2, 0]
            elif name == "-ROT"
                order = [2, 0, 1]
            elif name == "NIP"
                order = [1]
            elif name == "TUCK"
                order = [1, 0, 1]
            elif name == "2DUP"
                order = [0, 1, 0, 1]
            elif name == "2SWAP"
                order = [2, 3, 0, 1]
            elif name == "2OVER"
                order = [0, 1, 2, 3, 0, 1]
            try .push_values([for index := order[] then values[index]])
        elif includes_text(["TRUE", "FALSE", "DEPTH", "BL", "HERE", "BASE"], name)
            int value := if name == "TRUE" then -1 else (if name == "FALSE" or name == "BASE" then 0 else (if name == "DEPTH" then int(#data_stack) else (if name == "BL" then 32 else here_address())))
            try .push_data(value)
        elif name == "PICK" or name == "ROLL"
            int index := try .pop_data()
            if index < 0
                return .fail_with("invalid argument", -24)
            if int(#data_stack) <= index
                return .fail_with("stack underflow", -4)
            at := #data_stack - 1 - nat(index)
            value := data_stack[at]
            if name == "ROLL"
                data_stack = data_stack[:<at].concat(data_stack[at + 1:])
            try .push_data(value)
        elif name == "."
            int value := try .pop_data()
            pending += (try .format_number(value)) + " "
        elif name == ".R"
            int[] values := try .take_data(2)
            string text := try .format_number(values[0])
            padding := if values[1] > int(#text) then nat(values[1] - int(#text)) else 0
            pending += " " * padding + text
        elif name == ".S"
            string text := "<" + (try .format_number(int(#data_stack))) + "> "
            for value := data_stack[]
                text += (try .format_number(value)) + " "
            pending += text
        elif name == "?" or name == "@"
            int address := try .pop_data()
            nat index := try .cell_index(address)
            if name == "@"
                try .push_data(memory[index])
            else
                pending += (try .format_number(memory[index])) + " "
        elif name == "CR"
            .flush_line()
        elif name == "EMIT"
            int code := try .pop_data()
            if code < 32 or code > 126
                return .fail_with("invalid argument", -24)
            pending += printable_ascii()[code - 32]
        elif name == "SPACE"
            pending += " "
        elif name == "SPACES"
            int count := try .pop_data()
            if count > 0
                pending += " " * nat(count)
        elif name == "!" or name == "+!"
            int[] values := try .take_data(2)
            nat index := try .cell_index(values[1])
            memory[index] = if name == "!" then values[0] else memory[index] + values[0]
        elif name == ","
            int value := try .pop_data()
            memory = memory.append(value)
        elif name == "ALLOT"
            int count := try .pop_data()
            if count < 0 or count % 8 != 0
                return .fail_with("invalid argument", -24)
            memory = memory.concat([for i := (0:<int(count / 8))[] then 0])
        elif name == "HEX" or name == "DECIMAL"
            memory[0] = if name == "HEX" then 16 else 10
        elif includes_text(["CREATE", "VARIABLE", "CONSTANT", "VALUE", "DEFER"], name)
            string key := try .new_name()
            kind := if name == "CREATE" then "create" else (if name == "VARIABLE" then "variable" else (if name == "CONSTANT" then "constant" else (if name == "VALUE" then "value" else "defer")))
            item := ForthWord(key, kind)
            item.address = here_address()
            if name == "CONSTANT" or name == "VALUE"
                item.value = try .pop_data()
            .add_word(item)
            if name == "VARIABLE" or name == "VALUE"
                memory = memory.append(if name == "VALUE" then item.value else 0)
        elif name == "'"
            string key := try .read_name()
            nat id := try .existing_word(key)
            nat xt := .token_of(id)
            try .push_data(int(xt))
        elif name == "EXECUTE"
            int xt := try .pop_data()
            nat id := try .token_word(xt)
            try .execute_word(id, word_pool[id].name)
        elif name == "CATCH"
            int xt := try .pop_data()
            nat id := try .token_word(xt)
            saved := data_stack
            saved_return_size := #return_stack
            saved_depth := nesting_depth
            match .execute_word(id, word_pool[id].name)
                void
                    try .push_data(0)
                error failure
                    if not failure_catchable
                        return failure
                    data_stack = saved
                    if #return_stack > saved_return_size
                        return_stack = return_stack[:<saved_return_size]
                    nesting_depth = saved_depth
                    try .push_data(failure_code)
        elif name == "THROW"
            int code := try .pop_data()
            if code != 0
                return .fail_with("exception {code}", code)
        elif name == "ABORT"
            return .fail_with("aborted", -1)
        elif name == "WORDS"
            for: #dictionary > i >= 0
                pending += word_pool[dictionary[i]].name + " "
        return void

    void | error .run_definition(nat definition_id, nat start)
        if nesting_depth == 100
            return .fail_with("nesting too deep", -7)
        nesting_depth += 1
        return_size := #return_stack
        frame := [for i := (0:<nat(definitions[definition_id].local_count))[] then 0]
        ip := start
        while ip < #definitions[definition_id].body
            action := definitions[definition_id].body[ip]
            match .run_instruction(definition_id, action, ip + 1, &frame)
                nat next
                    ip = next
                error failure
                    if failure_word == ""
                        failure_word = action.token
                    return failure
        if #return_stack > return_size
            return_stack = return_stack[:<return_size]
        nesting_depth -= 1
        return void

    nat | error .run_instruction(nat definition_id, Instruction action, nat next, int[] &frame)
        op := action.op
        argument := action.argument
        if op == "call"
            try .execute_word(nat(argument), action.token)
        elif op == "push"
            try .push_data(argument)
        elif op == "local"
            try .push_data(frame[argument])
        elif op == "." + DQ
            pending += action.text
        elif op == "branch"
            return nat(argument)
        elif op == "zbranch"
            int value := try .pop_data()
            if value == 0
                return nat(argument)
        elif op == "DO" or op == "?DO"
            int[] values := try .take_data(2)
            if op == "?DO" and values[0] == values[1]
                return nat(argument)
            try .push_return(values[0])
            try .push_return(values[1])
        elif op == "LOOP" or op == "+LOOP"
            int step := if op == "LOOP" then 1 else try .pop_data()
            try .require_return(2)
            limit := return_stack[-2]
            index := return_stack[-1]
            if (index - limit < 0) != (index + step - limit < 0)
                return_stack = return_stack[:<#return_stack - 2]
            else
                return_stack[-1] = index + step
                return nat(argument)
        elif op == "LEAVE" or op == "UNLOOP"
            try .require_return(2)
            return_stack = return_stack[:<#return_stack - 2]
            if op == "LEAVE"
                return nat(argument)
        elif op == ">R"
            int value := try .pop_data()
            try .push_return(value)
        elif op == "R>"
            try .require_return(1)
            value := return_stack[-1]
            return_stack = return_stack[:<#return_stack - 1]
            try .push_data(value)
        elif op == "R@" or op == "I" or op == "J"
            nat count := if op == "J" then 3 else 1
            try .require_return(count)
            try .push_data(return_stack[#return_stack - count])
        elif op == "OF"
            int[] values := try .take_data(2)
            if values[0] != values[1]
                try .push_data(values[0])
                return nat(argument)
        elif op == "ENDCASE"
            try .pop_data()
        elif op == "ABORT" + DQ
            int value := try .pop_data()
            if value != 0
                return .fail_with(action.text, -2)
        elif op == "{{:"
            int[] values := try .take_data(#action.slots)
            for: i < #action.slots
                frame[action.slots[i]] = values[i]
        elif op == "to_local"
            frame[argument] = try .pop_data()
        elif op == "to_value"
            memory[word_pool[argument].address / 8] = try .pop_data()
        elif op == "IS"
            try .set_deferred(nat(argument))
        elif op == "RECURSE"
            try .run_definition(nat(argument), 0)
        elif op == "DOES>"
            if #dictionary == 0 or word_pool[dictionary[-1]].kind != "create"
                return .fail_with("no CREATE word", -31)
            id := dictionary[-1]
            word_pool[id].does_definition = int(definition_id)
            word_pool[id].does_start = nat(argument)
            return #definitions[definition_id].body
        elif op == "EXIT"
            return #definitions[definition_id].body
        return next

    nat .emit_instruction(string op, string token, argument := 0, text := "", nat[] slots := [])
        result := #definitions[compiling_id].body
        definitions[compiling_id].body = definitions[compiling_id].body.append(Instruction(op, token, argument, text, slots))
        return result

    void .patch(nat[] indices)
        for index := indices[]
            definitions[compiling_id].body[index].argument = int(#definitions[compiling_id].body)

    void | error .require_top(string[] kinds)
        controls := definitions[compiling_id].controls
        if #controls == 0 or not includes_text(kinds, controls[-1].kind)
            return .fail_with("control structure mismatch", catchable = false)
        return void

    ControlRecord .pop_control()
        last := #definitions[compiling_id].controls - 1
        result := definitions[compiling_id].controls[last]
        definitions[compiling_id].controls = definitions[compiling_id].controls[:<last]
        return result

    void .push_control(ControlRecord record)
        definitions[compiling_id].controls = definitions[compiling_id].controls.append(record)

    void | error .declare_locals(string token)
        string[] names := []
        while true
            string name := .read_word()
            if name == ""
                return .fail_with("unterminated locals", catchable = false)
            if name == ":}}"
                break
            names = names.append(name)
        for: i < #names
            if names[i] == "--"
                names = names[:<i]
                break
        for name := names[]
            try .check_name(name)
        nat[] slots := []
        for name := names[]
            slot := definitions[compiling_id].local_count
            .definitions[compiling_id].local_names.set(upper_ascii(name), slot)
            definitions[compiling_id].local_count += 1
            slots = slots.append(slot)
        .emit_instruction("{{:", token, slots = slots)
        return void

    void | error .compile_token(string token, string name)
        if name == "IF"
            nat index := .emit_instruction("zbranch", token)
            .push_control(ControlRecord("IF", index))
        elif name == "ELSE"
            try .require_top(["IF"])
            nat index := .emit_instruction("branch", token)
            ControlRecord previous := .pop_control()
            .patch([previous.origin])
            .push_control(ControlRecord("ELSE", index))
        elif name == "THEN"
            try .require_top(["IF", "ELSE"])
            ControlRecord previous := .pop_control()
            .patch([previous.origin])
        elif name == "BEGIN"
            .push_control(ControlRecord("BEGIN", #definitions[compiling_id].body))
        elif name == "UNTIL" or name == "AGAIN"
            try .require_top(["BEGIN"])
            ControlRecord previous := .pop_control()
            .emit_instruction(if name == "UNTIL" then "zbranch" else "branch", token, int(previous.origin))
        elif name == "WHILE"
            try .require_top(["BEGIN"])
            nat index := .emit_instruction("zbranch", token)
            ControlRecord previous := .pop_control()
            .push_control(ControlRecord("WHILE", previous.origin, [index]))
        elif name == "REPEAT"
            try .require_top(["WHILE"])
            ControlRecord previous := .pop_control()
            .emit_instruction("branch", token, int(previous.origin))
            .patch(previous.references)
        elif name == "DO" or name == "?DO"
            nat index := .emit_instruction(name, token)
            .push_control(ControlRecord(name, index + 1, if name == "?DO" then [index] else []))
        elif name == "LOOP" or name == "+LOOP"
            try .require_top(["DO", "?DO"])
            ControlRecord previous := .pop_control()
            .emit_instruction(name, token, int(previous.origin))
            .patch(previous.references)
        elif name == "LEAVE"
            loop_index := -1
            for: #definitions[compiling_id].controls > i >= 0
                if definitions[compiling_id].controls[i].kind == "DO" or definitions[compiling_id].controls[i].kind == "?DO"
                    loop_index = int(i)
                    break
            if loop_index < 0
                return .fail_with("control structure mismatch", catchable = false)
            nat index := .emit_instruction("LEAVE", token)
            definitions[compiling_id].controls[loop_index].references = definitions[compiling_id].controls[loop_index].references.append(index)
        elif name == "CASE"
            .push_control(ControlRecord("CASE"))
        elif name == "OF"
            try .require_top(["CASE"])
            nat index := .emit_instruction("OF", token)
            .push_control(ControlRecord("OF", index))
        elif name == "ENDOF"
            try .require_top(["OF"])
            nat index := .emit_instruction("branch", token)
            ControlRecord previous := .pop_control()
            .patch([previous.origin])
            last := #definitions[compiling_id].controls - 1
            definitions[compiling_id].controls[last].references = definitions[compiling_id].controls[last].references.append(index)
        elif name == "ENDCASE"
            try .require_top(["CASE"])
            .emit_instruction("ENDCASE", token)
            ControlRecord previous := .pop_control()
            .patch(previous.references)
        elif name == "RECURSE"
            .emit_instruction("RECURSE", token, compiling_id)
        elif name == "DOES>"
            if #definitions[compiling_id].controls > 0
                return .fail_with("control structure mismatch", catchable = false)
            .emit_instruction("DOES>", token, int(#definitions[compiling_id].body) + 1)
        elif name == ";"
            item := definitions[compiling_id]
            if #item.controls > 0
                kind := item.controls[-1].kind
                label := if kind == "ELSE" then "IF" else (if kind == "WHILE" then "BEGIN" else kind)
                return .fail_with("unclosed " + label, catchable = false)
            word := ForthWord(if item.name == "" then ":NONAME" else item.name, "colon")
            word.definition_id = compiling_id
            word.creation_here = item.creation_here
            id := #word_pool
            word_pool = word_pool.append(word)
            compiling_id = -1
            if item.name == ""
                nat xt := .token_of(id)
                try .push_data(int(xt))
            else
                dictionary = dictionary.append(id)
        elif name == "[']"
            string key := try .read_name()
            nat id := try .existing_word(key)
            nat xt := .token_of(id)
            .emit_instruction("push", token, int(xt))
        elif name == "{{:"
            try .declare_locals(token)
        elif includes_text(["EXIT", ">R", "R>", "R@", "I", "J", "UNLOOP"], name)
            .emit_instruction(name, token)
        else
            match definitions[compiling_id].local_names.get(name)
                nat slot
                    .emit_instruction("local", token, int(slot))
                none
                    int id := find_word(name)
                    if id < 0
                        int value := try .number_literal(token)
                        .emit_instruction("push", token, value)
                    else
                        .emit_instruction("call", token, id)
        return void

    void | error .process_token(string token)
        name := upper_ascii(token)
        compiling := compiling_id >= 0
        if name == "\"
            read_position = #input_line
        elif name == "("
            match input_line[read_position:].find(")")
                nat at
                    read_position += at + 1
                none
                    return .fail_with("unterminated comment", catchable = false)
        elif not compiling and compile_only(name)
            return .fail_with("compile only", catchable = false)
        elif compiling and interpret_only(name)
            return .fail_with("interpret only", catchable = false)
        elif name == "." + DQ or name == "ABORT" + DQ
            string text := try .read_string()
            if compiling
                .emit_instruction(name, token, text = text)
            else
                pending += text
        elif name == "TO" or name == "IS"
            string raw := try .read_name()
            key := upper_ascii(raw)
            if name == "TO" and compiling
                match definitions[compiling_id].local_names.get(key)
                    nat slot
                        .emit_instruction("to_local", token, int(slot))
                        return
                    none
                        void
            nat id := try .existing_word(raw)
            expected := if name == "TO" then "value" else "defer"
            if word_pool[id].kind != expected
                return .fail_with(if name == "TO" then "not a value" else "not deferred", catchable = false, token = raw)
            if compiling
                .emit_instruction(if name == "TO" then "to_value" else "IS", token, int(id))
            elif name == "TO"
                memory[word_pool[id].address / 8] = try .pop_data()
            else
                try .set_deferred(id)
        elif name == ":" or name == ":NONAME"
            string raw := if name == ":" then try .read_name() else token
            if name == ":"
                try .check_name(raw)
            compiling_id = int(#definitions)
            definitions = definitions.append(Definition(if name == ":" then upper_ascii(raw) else "", raw, here_address()))
        elif name == "FORGET"
            string raw := try .read_name()
            key := upper_ascii(raw)
            for: #dictionary > i >= 0
                id := dictionary[i]
                if word_pool[id].name == key
                    memory = memory[:<nat(word_pool[id].creation_here / 8)]
                    dictionary = dictionary[:<i]
                    return
            return .fail_with("undefined word", -13, token = raw)
        elif compiling
            try .compile_token(token, name)
        else
            int id := find_word(name)
            if id < 0
                int value := try .number_literal(token)
                try .push_data(value)
            else
                try .execute_word(nat(id), token)
        return void

    void .process_line(string line)
        input_line = line
        read_position = 0
        while true
            string token := .read_word()
            if token == ""
                break
            match .process_token(token)
                void
                    void
                error failure
                    if pending != ""
                        .flush_line()
                    emit("ERROR " + (if failure_word == "" then token else failure_word) + ": " + failure_reason)
                    data_stack = []
                    return_stack = []
                    nesting_depth = 0
                    compiling_id = -1
                    break
        if pending != ""
            .flush_line()

    void finish()
        if compiling_id >= 0
            emit("ERROR " + definitions[compiling_id].display + ": unterminated definition")

void read_program()
    interpreter := Interpreter()
    .interpreter.initialize()
    line := ""
    while true
        match scan(&line)
            void
                void
            error failure
                break
        if line == "BYE"
            break
        .interpreter.process_line(line)
    interpreter.finish()

read_program()
